title: The Economics of Intelligence: How and when does AGI lead to economic transformation?
author_or_organization: Alex Imas, Andrew Koh, and Shane Legg (DeepMind Institute)
source_type: economic theory essay & organizational scaling framework
limitations: Conceptual and equilibrium-modeling essay drawing on the working paper Organizing Intelligence (arXiv:2611.05417) rather than firm-level causal econometrics. Its primary original empirical illustration is a stylized 100-person, six-domain quiz (+32% gain for complementary vs. random pairings), supplemented by qualitative industry observations (such as Noam Brown on multi-agent math runs). Carries the official DMI disclaimer that it reflects the authors’ research rather than Google’s corporate view; whether and when multi-agent systems cross the supercooperative threshold remains an open empirical question.
